segments.name: Advertising
segments.note: Ads across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger — up 26% YoY, on 10% more ad impressions and 14% higher average price per ad. 98% of total revenue.

segments.name: Family of Apps other revenue
segments.note: Non-advertising revenue from the apps (e.g. subscriptions, business messaging) — up 59% YoY.

segments.name: Reality Labs
segments.note: Quest headsets and smart glasses — down 6% YoY, and still deeply loss-making with a $4,129M operating loss.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building AI, the metaverse and the apps — up 32% YoY.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Includes a $9,890M charge to settle teen mental-health litigation with US State Attorneys General; without it, G&A would have been about $4,967M.

oneTimers: Q3 2026 G&A includes a $9,890M charge for the August 2026 agreement with US State Attorneys General resolving teen mental-health/social-media litigation (payments of up to ~$18,590M in total). Excluding it: operating income would have been $22,880M, diluted EPS $7.40, effective tax rate 17% (vs 24% reported). Prior-year Q3 net income was itself depressed by an outsized $18,954M tax provision (87% effective tax rate), so the +264% net-income growth overstates the underlying trend.
verdict: Meta's ads grew 26% to $64.6B, but a $9.9B legal settlement cut operating profit by more than a third — and the number to watch is the $7.40 it would have earned without it.
footerNote: Reality Labs lost $4,129M this quarter; full-year 2026 Reality Labs losses are now expected at $18-19B.
follow100Note: R&D eats $31 of every $100 — Meta spends more on research than it keeps as profit. The rows add to $100.01 due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Ads are still a money machine
takeaways.text: Advertising grew 26% to $63.1B — 98% of all revenue — on 10% more impressions and 14% higher prices.

takeaways.title: One settlement cut profit by a third
takeaways.text: A $9.9B charge to settle teen mental-health litigation with state attorneys general cut operating profit 37%. Without it, EPS would have been $7.40, not $3.83.

takeaways.title: Reality Labs still burns billions
takeaways.text: The metaverse division lost $4.1B this quarter on just $443M of revenue — and Meta now expects $18-19B of Reality Labs losses for the full year.
